figurative_meaning_en: To become agitated or excited; to provoke anger
similar_in_english: To get hot under the collar
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথায় আমার মাথা গরম হয়ে গেল।
সে আজেবাজে কথা বলে সবার মাথা গরম করে।
example_sentences_in_english: His words made my head hot and I got really angry.
He provokes everyone by talking nonsense and making their heads hot.
note: The idiom uses the metaphor of a 'hot head' to describe rising temper, common in South Asian linguistic traditions.
